```{r}
data("College")
view(College)
```

```{r}
dim(College)
```
```{r}
summary(College)
```
```{r}
pairs(College[,1:5])
```
```{r}
Elite = rep("NO",nrow(College))
Elite[College$Top10perc>50]="YES"
College.df = data.frame(College,Elite)
```


```{r}
view(College.df)
```

```{r}
summary(College.df)
```

```{r}
hist(College$Apps,xlim = c(0,2500),xlab = "Applications",main = "Apps using defalut bin size")
```
```{r}
hist(College$Apps,xlim = c(0,2500),breaks = 25,xlab = "Applications",main = "Apps using smaller bin size")

```

```{r}
hist(College$Top10perc,breaks = 25,xlab = "Pct. new students from top 10% of H.S. class", main = "Top10perc")
```
```{r}
hist(College$Outstate,xlab = "Out-of-state tution",ylab = "Amount",main = "Outstate")
```
